name: loyal-spark
description: Onchain loyalty on Base for merchants and AI agents. Connects Cursor and Grok Bot to Loyal Spark merchant (lsk_) and holder (rwk_) MCP servers to deploy B20 loyalty tokens, register programs, create rewards, mint, and redeem.

LSK_KEY.title: Merchant API key (lsk_)
LSK_KEY.description: Optional Loyal Spark merchant agent key (starts with lsk_). Needed for create, mint, rewards, and trade tools. Leave empty for keyless tools/list and get_platform_info. Get one via $0.01 x402 register-agent or SIWE.

RWK_KEY.title: Holder API key (rwk_)
RWK_KEY.description: Optional Loyal Spark holder/recipient key (starts with rwk_). Needed for wallet-scoped holder tools. Free via SIWE at /recipient-api/register. Leave empty if you only use the merchant server.
